moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins this Saturday, a week later than usual due to the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Excitement
angles.copy: New season, new hopes! The Premier League is back this Saturday. Who's lifting the trophy next May? #PremierLeague

angles.name: Team Predictions
angles.copy: From title contenders to relegation battles – what are your fearless predictions for the 2026/27 Premier League season? Kick-off is just days away!

moments.title: Community Shield Winners
moments.blurb: The 2026 Community Shield was played on Sunday at Cardiff's Principality Stadium, with Arsenal facing Manchester City.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Shield
angles.copy: Cardiff delivered the curtain-raiser for the football season on Sunday! What a spectacle at the Principality Stadium for the Community Shield.

angles.name: First Trophy Claimed
angles.copy: The first silverware of the season has been claimed! Did your team start with a win in the Community Shield?

moments.title: The Hundred Finals
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament concluded its 2026 season on Sunday with Finals Day at Lord's, crowning both men's and women's champions.

angles.name: Cricket Champions Crowned
angles.copy: Big congratulations to the winners of The Hundred 2026! What a thrilling Finals Day at Lord's on Sunday.

angles.name: Summer Cricket Review
angles.copy: The Hundred has wrapped up for another year – did your team go all the way? We're already looking forward to next summer's action.

moments.title: Strictly Buzz Builds
moments.blurb: The celebrity line-up for Strictly Come Dancing 2026 was completed on August 12, with the launch show set to be pre-recorded on September 9 and air on September 19.

angles.name: Strictly Line-Up Complete
angles.copy: The full line-up for Strictly Come Dancing 2026 is locked in! Who are you most excited to see hit the dancefloor this autumn?

angles.name: New Hosts Ready
angles.copy: New hosts, new dancers, new celebs! The Strictly Come Dancing launch show is just weeks away. Get ready for the glitterball to return!

moments.title: John Deacon's 75th Birthday
moments.blurb: Queen bassist and songwriter John Deacon, who penned hits like 'Another One Bites the Dust', celebrates his 75th birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Deacy
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we're wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary, and notoriously private, John Deacon of Queen! What's your favourite Deacon-penned track?

angles.name: Queen's Bass Master
angles.copy: From 'Another One Bites the Dust' to 'I Want to Break Free', John Deacon's basslines are iconic. Happy 75th for tomorrow!

moments.title: Robert Plant's 78th Birthday
moments.blurb: Led Zeppelin frontman Robert Plant, known for his powerful vocals and songwriting, celebrates his 78th birthday on Thursday.

angles.name: Led Zeppelin Legend
angles.copy: Happy 78th birthday on Thursday to the one and only Robert Plant! Still rocking, still iconic.

angles.name: Golden God's Voice
angles.copy: From 'Stairway to Heaven' to a stellar solo career, Robert Plant's voice is legendary. Wishing him a fantastic 78th for Thursday!

moments.title: Demi Lovato's 34th Birthday

angles.name: Celebrating Demi

angles.name: Pop Powerhouse
angles.copy: From Camp Rock to chart-topper, Demi Lovato turns 34 on Thursday! Celebrate her powerful voice with us.

angles.name: Farewell To Summer
angles.copy: Get ready for the last bank holiday of summer on August 31st! How are you making the most of it?
